case_number: 2023 INSC 830; Civil Appeal No(s). 10069 of 2016; Civil Appeal No(s). 5005-5007 of 2019; Civil Appeal No(s). 2737 of 2016; Civil Appeal No(s). 5400 of 2016; Civil Appeal No(s). 26756 of 2016; Civil Appeal No(s). 3881-3882 of 2019

parties.petitioner: Kerala State Co-Operative Agricultural And Rural Development Bank Ltd.

summary: Co-operative bank status vs agricultural credit society; Section 80P(2)(a)(i) deduction eligibility; 'co-operative bank' exclusion under Section 80P(4); interpretation of State Co-operative Societies Act, 1969 & 1984; NABARD Act linkage; apex society status; banking business test; land mortgage vs development bank function; partial allowance of deduction upheld; High Court judgment challenged; final order in favor of appellant on scope of business.
legal_provisions_cited: Kerala State Co-Operative Agricultural Development Banks Act, 1984
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Act, 1981
final_judgment: Leave granted; appeals allowed in part; ITAT order modified to allow deduction under Section 80P(2)(a)(i) for lending activities as State Land Development Bank; High Court judgment set aside.
